hints.tr: Dört ayrı `if` yaz, `elif` değil: birden çok kapı aynı anda kapanabilir.
hints.en: Write four separate `if`s, not `elif`: several gates can close at the same time.

hints.tr: Kapsam tam eşikteyse kapı geçer: koşul `results["coverage"] < min_coverage`.
hints.en: If coverage is exactly at the threshold the gate passes: the condition is `results["coverage"] < min_coverage`.
